speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the consultation. I understand you have been experiencing episodic cough and shortness of breath; to determine the cause, I need to ask a few specific questions about your symptoms. How long have these episodes been occurring, and what seems to trigger them?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pertussis (Whooping Cough).

The patient's initial URI symptoms 8 weeks ago followed by a 1-month history of paroxysmal, nonproductive cough and dyspnea are classic for the paroxysmal stage of pertussis. I will proceed with ordering a Pertussis PCR test. REQUEST TEST: Pertussis_PCR
